assumptions.body_heading: Tangent at body centre; global body lateral translation minimised, no independently floating yaw-only pivots.
assumptions.stock_screen: Every point of the full finite stock box is conservatively required to remain in the radial gap envelope. This is stricter than a point-pole screen; a fitted spatial map still requires exact active pole faces.
assumptions.underbody_width: 3.0m is a revised package-clearance target, compared with current2.65m body width; it is not an approved city structure/clearance.

next_design: Compare150m terminal curves with counted four/five-carrier yaw/slide mechanisms and a3.0m underbody clearance target. Recount joints, coolers and separate guidance before force/control/route adoption.
